title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Returns and Credit Builder Returned-Payment Fees
content:
The returned-payment fee on a Credit Builder account is reduced when a payment on the borrower's Larkspur FlexLine was also returned recently. The returns are read from the borrower's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit ledger: its returned-payment entries and their dates.

## FlexLine returns and the fee

- When a payment on the borrower's Larkspur FlexLine was returned less than one whole calendar month before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month one month earlier falls outside), the fee is multiplied by the same-month other-line share of 0.5.
- When no FlexLine payment was returned in that month but one was returned less than three whole calendar months before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month three months earlier falls outside), the fee is multiplied by the same-quarter other-line share of 0.75.
- When no FlexLine payment was returned in those three months, the fee is not reduced for other Larkspur returns.

The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Latest FlexLine payment return | Share |
|---|---|
| within the 1 whole calendar month before today | 0.5 |
| within the 3 whole calendar months, not within the 1 month | 0.75 |
| none within the 3 months | no reduction |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

Today 15 April: a FlexLine return dated 16 March is within the month; one dated 15 March is outside the month but within the three months; one dated 15 January falls outside the three months.
